dataset: Dancing Fish Granola Berry Crunch (Official Esko AIForge Organizer Package)
scope: Independent Adjudicated Answer Key for 16 Candidate Quality & Compliance Checks + Positive Control

adjudicationMetadata.methodology: Source-Grounded Deterministic Verification against US FDA Title 21 CFR and GS1 Specifications

checks.title: Honey Percentage Discrepancy
checks.reasoningSummary: Spreadsheet cell B26 declares 9% honey while physical carton prints 1% honey. Because spreadsheet has Draft/In-Review status, this represents a discrepancy requiring formulation confirmation.
checks.uncertainties: Content sheet is marked Draft / In Review; cannot confirm whether 1% or 9% is the approved production recipe without R&D sign-off.

checks.title: Ingredient List Discrepancies & Duplication

actualVerifiedSourceFacts.sourceDuplicate: Sunflower Seeds appears twice in cell B26

checks.reasoningSummary: Carton lists 4 ingredients absent from the draft spreadsheet formulation, and the spreadsheet formulation contains an internal duplicate declaration of Sunflower Seeds.
checks.uncertainties: Ingredients on carton may reflect a revised formulation not yet updated in the draft spreadsheet.

checks.title: Allergen Disclosure & Precautionary Review
checks.reasoningSummary: Tree nuts are explicitly named in the ingredient list, satisfying statutory FALCPA 21 U.S.C. 343(w) disclosure. The precautionary statement uses generic 'Nuts' rather than specific tree nut species, triggering brand/regulatory policy review.
checks.uncertainties: Federal law permits ingredient-list-only disclosure; separate 'Contains' statement is not universally mandatory under US law.

checks.title: No Added Sugar Claim & 0g Added Sugars Review
checks.reasoningSummary: Under 21 CFR §101.60(c)(2), a 'No Added Sugar' claim is unlawful if the product contains added sugars unless explicitly qualified. The recipe contains honey, coconut sugar, and cane sugar.
checks.uncertainties: Quantitative '0g Added Sugars' in Nutrition Facts may technically qualify for zero rounding only if total added sugars are <0.5g per serving.

checks.title: Vegan Claim Formulation Consistency
checks.reasoningSummary: Honey is an animal-derived product excluded under standard vegan definitions. The presence of honey and 45mg cholesterol contradicts the 'Suitable for Vegans' claim.
checks.uncertainties: FDA does not regulate 'vegan' by statute, but FTC Section 5 prohibits deceptive claims and certification standards exclude honey.

checks.title: Carbohydrate Source Mismatch
checks.reasoningSummary: Carbohydrate value differs by 51g between draft sheet and printed carton. If comparing different quantity columns (e.g. 100g vs serving), basis must be reconciled.
checks.uncertainties: Content sheet contains columns for 250g, 480g, and 1000g; values must be compared like-for-like.

checks.title: Sodium Source Mismatch
checks.reasoningSummary: Sodium value differs by 2mg between specification sheet and carton.
checks.uncertainties: Under FDA rounding rules (21 CFR 101.9(c)(4)), sodium <= 140mg rounds to nearest 5mg; 23mg is an unrounded label value.

checks.title: Total Fat Daily Value (%DV) Calculation
checks.reasoningSummary: 15g / 78g = 19.23%. Printed 2.2% DV is off by 17 percentage points; severe mathematical discrepancy.
checks.uncertainties: None. FDA 2016 nutrition labeling reference Daily Value is strictly 78g for adults and children >= 4 years.

checks.title: Vitamin D Daily Value (%DV) Calculation
checks.reasoningSummary: 89mcg / 20mcg = 445%. Printed 12% DV is off by 433 percentage points; severe mathematical discrepancy.
checks.uncertainties: None. FDA reference Daily Value is strictly 20 mcg for adults.

checks.title: Atwater 9/4/4 Calorie Plausibility Consistency
checks.reasoningSummary: Calculated energy is 535 kcal vs printed 166 kcal (divergence of 369 kcal).
checks.uncertainties: Atwater 9/4/4 is a general screening method; specific energy factors, insoluble fiber subtractions, and serving bases must be verified.

checks.title: Servings × Serving Size vs Net Weight Consistency
checks.reasoningSummary: 8 * 85g = 680g, which exceeds declared pack mass of 480g by 200g (41.7%).
checks.uncertainties: Declared serving size lacks gram unit and is mathematically incompatible with 8 servings in 480g net contents.

checks.title: Foreign / EU-style Visible Content on US Pack
checks.reasoningSummary: EU Reference Intake icons and Annex II allergen phrasing are visible on a package intended for US retail.
checks.uncertainties: EU elements are not illegal per se under US law unless misleading, but violate standard packaging market separation rules.

checks.title: Hidden Obsolete EU Nutrition Table Detection
checks.reasoningSummary: Legacy EU nutrition table is physically covered by an opaque white vector rectangle. PackSignal correctly identifies it as hidden and excludes it from visible compliance.
checks.uncertainties: Text is non-printing/occluded; does not represent a consumer copy defect.

checks.title: Net Quantity Format and Placement
checks.reasoningSummary: Net quantity is declared in metric units only on the Back Panel; US law requires dual customary and metric units placed in the bottom 30% of the Principal Display Panel.
checks.uncertainties: None. 15 U.S.C. 1453 and 21 CFR §101.7 strictly mandate PDP bottom-30% placement.

checks.title: Manufacturer / Distributor Business Address

actualVerifiedSourceFacts.declaredText: PRODUCED BY DANCING FISH GRANOLA CO.

checks.reasoningSummary: 21 CFR §101.5 requires place of business to include city, state, and ZIP code; only company name appears.
checks.uncertainties: Street address can be omitted if listed in local telephone or city directory, but city, state, and ZIP are mandatory.

checks.title: Draft / Unapproved Source Authority Blocker
checks.reasoningSummary: Content sheet has not received final release sign-off. Engine must not treat unapproved source values as definitive ground truth.
checks.uncertainties: Governance blocker requiring brand manager or regulatory reviewer sign-off.

checks.title: UPC-A Barcode Modulo-10 Check Digit (Positive Control)
checks.reasoningSummary: The numeric UPC-A check digit 6 is mathematically valid under GS1 Modulo-10. This is a clean positive control.
checks.uncertainties: A valid checksum proves numerical integrity but does not evaluate print contrast or barcode quiet zones.
